ZOHERY TOURS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

Transportation Services

Zohery Tours offers diversified transportation services to suit individual and corporate needs. Our goal is to provide our clients with the highest quality transportation services so that getting to your destination becomes a great travel experience. We operate a 24 hour in-house dispatch center and are able to get you any vehicle you need in no time. Whether you’re a large corporation, hotel or an organization, if you’re looking for an airport shuttle, a charter bus or transportation service service to Washington DC, Maryland or Virginia, Zohery Tours  is your #1 choice. Our qualified staff is trained to assist you with all your travel plans while our professional drivers are ready to help you reach your destination. Zohery Tours has a unique experience in shuttling staff and teams throughout the D.C. metro area and service conference centers for major events. Our fleet includes minibuses that seat up to 20 passengers, coach buses that seat up to 47 passengers, and more.

CORPORATE EVENTS
If you have a corporate event in Washington DC or a business meeting to attend, Zohery Tours can help with point to point service. We have extensive experience in providing impeccable services to a wide array of clients, including those in the government sector, the private sector, hotels, universities, and real estate and construction companies.

AIRPORT TRANSFERS

Zohery Tours provides exclusive services shuttling people to  Washington D.C.’s most popular convention locations. Airport transfers are provided to and from the three area airports: Ronald Regan Washington National Airport, Dulles International Airport and Baltimore Washington International Airport.

CORPORATE TRANSPORTATION

In any event your company needs transportation of personnel, Zohery Tours provides exclusive services to corporate clients, including sedan, and shuttle services.

  • Individuals and Groups:

If you are looking for bus transport for your guests, or even a ride for a night out on the town, Zohery Tours will work to make your experience a pleasant one that you will remember!

  • Embassies:

Zohery Tours’ expansive experience spanning 30 offering transportation services to the international travelers and diplomats will ensure that your needs will be met in an expedient and professional manner. Should you require special security measures and procedures, arrangements will be made to have you covered.
Additionally, we provide daily shuttle service to and from:

  • Office Complexes
  • Metro Stations
  • Off-site Parking Facilities
  • Hospitals and Medical Facilities
  • Colleges and Universities
  • Religious Facilities
  • Event Transportation

For more information or to make a reservation call us today at 202-554-4200 or send us a message on our contact form.
No matter the number of passengers, Zohery Tours can manage your daily shuttle service needs. By providing a variety of car service, bus service, and other vehicle options, we can tailor your shuttle route to be the greenest and most cost effective transportation solution. Our staff works hard to ensure that riders arrive at their destination in a safe and timely manner.
